author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅರಿತುನಡೆ ಸಾಧಕನೆ ಸಾಧನೆಗೆ ಮಿತಿಯಿಲ್ಲ
ಮರೆಸುವುದು ಮಮಕಾರ ಸನಿಹವಿಹ ಗುರಿಯ
ತೆರೆನಿನ್ನ ಕಣ್ಣುಗಳ ಮಿಥ್ಯವಿಹ ಜಗದೊಳಗೆ
ದೊರೆಯುವುದು ಗೆಲುವಪಥ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Walk with understanding, O seeker; there is no limit to sādhana;
attachment hides the goal that lies close at hand;
open your eyes within this world of illusion:
the path to victory will be found, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Spiritual practice has no end, so walk with awareness. Attachment hides a goal that is in fact very near. Open your eyes in this illusory world, and the way to success will appear.
